name: Raising On Purpose - Pinterest via Buffer (2x daily)

nodes.name: Take Pinterest Channel + Build Boards Query

parameters.content:
## Pinterest x Buffer setup (do once)
1. API key: Buffer > Settings > API > Generate API Key (that exact screen). Keep ALL permissions checked. Set the LONGEST expiration (a 30-day key silently breaks this in a month). Paste the key over YOUR_BUFFER_API_KEY in the 4 Buffer HTTP nodes.
2. Pinterest must be connected (Publishing > Channels). The workflow auto-finds the channel + uses its FIRST board. To pin to a different board, edit Take Board node: boards[0] -> boards[N].
3. Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID_HERE (Read Sheet + Mark Pinned). Add `Pinned` and `Pinned At` columns to the same sheet.
4. Schedule runs 9:00 + 15:00 SERVER time. Railway = UTC: set env N8N_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE (e.g. America/New_York) or shift cron hours.
5. Posts land in the Pinterest channel queue (addToQueue) and send on that channel posting schedule. One run = one pin (oldest Done + unpinned). Empty queue = run ends silently.
